description: Approve a pending request and execute the target action in the same transaction. Requires a service JWT (com.atproto.server.getServiceAuth) and security.write. The requester cannot approve their own request; expired or already executed requests are refused.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller lacks security.write or tried to approve their own request.

errors.name: ApprovalState
errors.description: The request is expired, already decided or cannot be executed.
